scope: All 300 games present in the baseline inventory before expansion; proposed modes are review findings, not implemented changes.

definitions.existing: An actual selectable optional endless mode or verified uncapped run exists in source/UI.
definitions.suitable: A bounded extension uses existing renewable/live mechanics without changing the defining contest; implementation and late-run balancing still required.
definitions.conditional: Plausible only with validated content generation/renewal, extra run-level resource rules or an explicitly separate variant.
definitions.inappropriate: Continuous endless play defeats the defining finite contest/story; separately labelled completed-match/scenario series may still be useful.
definitions.continuousChallengeChain: Different certified finite tasks share cumulative score/progression and one run-level failure reserve; individual tasks can finish without ending the run.
definitions.matchSeries: Complete competitive matches retain winners/draws and reset their board/hand between games; this is not continuous endless gameplay.

limitations: Source-level feasibility review only; no proposed baseline endless modes were implemented or dynamically exercised.
Generator witnesses, bounded resource economies, late-run difficulty and memory safety are gates for future implementations, not claims that current finite content is endless.
Sources use compressed lines in several rooms; function names, exact excerpts and SHA-256 hashes identify the audited rule beyond line numbers.
Ordinary finite-play evidence in existing repository tests is separate from this static audit; this artifact does not claim a new 300-game browser playthrough.
